title: An imported FSD (contract source-document v2, Phase 2b, slice 2.2)
description: A document converted to text by code (D13, D52): never rewritten by AI. The original is archived and cited by archive name, path and content hash (D16). Stored in specs/fsd/<id>/document.json beside document.md and its images. v2 adds each section's permanentId beside its id (D117); nothing else changed.

archive.description: The archive's name from stangent.yaml, not its location.

id.description: The FSD's own number (4.2.3), or the heading path where a section has none. It can change between versions. Saved links and requirements cite it, and input hashes use it.

permanentId.description: The section's id across versions of this document, from the document's ledger (specs/fsd/<id>/ids.json). Never reused; a removed id stays marked removed there.

text.description: The section's own text, up to the next heading.

problems.description: What couldn't be brought in exactly, in people's words: duplicate, missing or out-of-order section numbers; for a PDF also pages with no text, removed running headers and footers, tables kept as plain text, section titles not found, unread images; for a Word file also accepted tracked changes, hidden text left out, comments (one line each, in a fixed shape: comment: section <id> by <author> open or resolved: <text>, each value a JSON string), embedded objects and flattened tables by kind and section, and any mismatch from the completeness check. Reported, never guessed.
